patterns.name: Continuation command executes bounded work
patterns.definition: A continuation command resolves the exact unfinished item, performs it, validates it, and reports evidence.
patterns.preserve_by: Bootstrap command semantics and active checkpoint.

patterns.name: Shared core with domain capability modules
patterns.definition: Heterogeneous game objects retain common identity and governance while using type-specific mechanical modules.
patterns.preserve_by: Canonical object family, capability registry, and template composition.

patterns.name: Variants, conflicts, and incompleteness remain visible
patterns.definition: The workflow preserves source variants and missing information instead of fabricating a clean but false canon.

patterns.name: Repository-first recovery
patterns.definition: New work recovers authority and state from canonical repositories rather than conversational memory.
patterns.preserve_by: Static prompt, bootstrap, pointer, checkpoint, branch, PR, and CI evidence.

patterns.name: Evidence-backed completion
patterns.definition: Completion reports identify exact commits, pull requests, checks, artifacts, and merge state.

patterns.name: Owner correction becomes durable policy
patterns.definition: A repeated correction is converted from a conversational preference into a governed contract or automated check.
patterns.preserve_by: Owner-AI contract, regression case, and bootstrap rule.

patterns.name: Parallel tracks remain explicit
patterns.definition: A side mission does not silently complete, abandon, or supersede application and design tracks.

patterns.name: Owner-only gates are explicit
patterns.definition: The assistant proceeds through reversible work and stops only for spending, credentials, release, deployment, or irreversible owner decisions.
patterns.preserve_by: Contributor registry and owner-decision boundary fields.

patterns.name: Milestone explanation is available on demand
patterns.definition: When asked, the assistant explains purpose, remaining work, and implications without resetting the project.
patterns.preserve_by: Roadmap index and concise owner-facing status projection.

patterns.name: Private interaction evidence is minimized
patterns.definition: Raw conversations remain owner-held while public governance stores only hashes, aggregate counts, paraphrased episodes, and evaluation requirements.
